Unmarked 0-side ''Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan'' slip showing the original Set 3 text, including the Devastator condition on forfeiting Tantive IV.

== Source ==

* Players Committee, [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222826id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/MasterList.pdf#page=23 Virtual Card Slips Master List], Set 3 Light Side, PDF p. 23, center column. Captured 6 August 2016.
* Players Committee, [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806182910id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-3.pdf#page=4 Virtual Set 3], PDF p. 4, center column. Captured 6 August 2016. This source renders the same pixels.

== File details ==

The publisher’s PDF panel was rendered at 300 dpi and cropped to the original slip, including the printed bottom margin.
